SOURCE_RECEIPT.capture: Installed Chrome via Playwright; wait for lazy prices, bounded scroll, save settled HTML; no individual product pages by default.
SOURCE_RECEIPT.local_evidence: Bounded live run: 137 unique products, 74 complete price pairs, 12 listing pages, 0 failed pages.
SOURCE_RECEIPT.variant_policy: Dedupe by product URL/SKU; conflicting prices or variants are flagged, not merged.
SOURCE_RECEIPT.limitations: Retailer edge protection varies; live rights/terms review and independent acceptance remain open.

PAGING_RECEIPT.strategy: Bounded same-host sale/clearance link queue, depth 2, maximum 12 secondary listing pages.
PAGING_RECEIPT.page_2_evidence: Category and Top 100 links discovered from the landing page; no product-page fallback in the current live test path.

PRICE_EXTRACTION_RECEIPT.current_price_role: Observed customer price on the listing card.
PRICE_EXTRACTION_RECEIPT.regular_price_role: Observed regular/comparable price on the same card.
PRICE_EXTRACTION_RECEIPT.rejections: Incomplete pairs, conflicting variants/prices and missing prices are excluded from the 20-candidate discount selection.

RIGHTS_RECEIPT.note: Local browser run only; Best Buy terms and access permission are not independently accepted.
